malaysia.name: Kuala Lumpur + Penang, Malaysia
malaysia.tagline: Petronas skyline, Penang heritage and street food
malaysia.whyParents: Singapore-style food and skyline for less, plus George Town's colonial UNESCO streets.
malaysia.stay: KL: Bukit Bintang, walk to Jalan Alor and Pavilion. Penang: George Town heritage core, walk to street art and hawkers.
malaysia.getAround: KL: Grab, LRT and monorail. ETS Platinum train KL Sentral to Butterworth ~4h, then ferry to George Town. Grab in Penang. No car.
malaysia.entry: Visa-free up to 90 days; passport valid 6 months. Free MDAC online within 3 days before arrival; avoid fee sites.
events: MetMalaysia: Northeast Monsoon runs Oct 27 2026 to Mar 2027, heaviest rain and rough seas on east coast and South China Sea side
Christmas decorations at Pavilion KL and KLCC malls (annual; 2026 dates not announced)
pros: Superb cheap street food, Penang especially
English widely spoken, easy Grab rides
cons: Hot, humid, ~90F with afternoon storms in KL
Two of seven days lost to flying
unverified: No dated Dec 12/19 2026 fare seen; $1,550 is a peak-season estimate
Cathay winter 2026/27 PEN-HKG and HKG-JFK timings not confirmed; fallback is MH/AirAsia PEN-KUL (~1h) to connect at KUL
ETS Platinum KL-Butterworth fare (~$20) not confirmed; check ktmb.com.my
Lodging: no 2BR December listing prices seen; based on market averages
MDAC official portal is via imi.gov.my; exact URL not confirmed (several fake fee sites exist)
2026 Christmas decor dates at Pavilion/KLCC not announced
Petronas Skybridge and Penang Hill funicular hours and prices not checked
malaysia.precip: KL: afternoon thunderstorms most days (~250 mm, 18-20 rain days). Penang drier (~140 mm, ~14 days). Monsoon hits east coast, not this route.
malaysia.flightText: Cathay Pacific: JFK-HKG-KUL Dec 12, land KUL Dec 13. Return PEN-HKG-JFK Dec 19 (CX634 PEN 13:00, seen operating 2026), home Dec 19.. Cathay is oneworld (AA miles). Alts: Turkish via Istanbul, Qatar via Doha (check Middle East disruptions), Singapore Airlines via SIN. Capital One partners: Cathay Asia Miles, Turkish, KrisFlyer. No PHL nonstop to Asia.

itinerary.title: Land KL, Petronas lights
itinerary.plan: Arrive KLIA Dec 13, Grab to Bukit Bintang. Evening KLCC Park fountain show under lit Petronas Towers.

itinerary.title: Old KL + Chinatown
itinerary.plan: Merdeka Square, Sultan Abdul Samad Building, Central Market crafts, Petaling Street. Petronas Skybridge late afternoon.
itinerary.eat: Hokkien mee at Kim Lian Kee, Petaling Street

itinerary.title: Batu Caves + Thean Hou
itinerary.plan: Early Batu Caves (272 steps) before heat and storms, afternoon Thean Hou Temple, evening Pavilion Christmas decor.

itinerary.title: Train to Penang
itinerary.plan: Morning ETS Platinum KL Sentral to Butterworth (~4h), ferry to George Town, sunset Esplanade and City Hall walk.
itinerary.eat: Char kway teow on Lebuh Kimberley

itinerary.title: Penang Hill + Kek Lok Si
itinerary.plan: Funicular up Penang Hill for island views, then Kek Lok Si pagoda and Kuan Yin statue.

itinerary.title: Street art + clan houses
itinerary.plan: Armenian Street murals, Khoo Kongsi clan temple, Chew Jetty stilt houses, Little India. Evening hawker crawl.

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.plan: Roti canai breakfast, Grab to Penang airport (~30 min). Cathay via Hong Kong, land JFK Dec 19 evening.

china.name: Beijing + Xi'an, China (ending in Hong Kong)
china.tagline: Great Wall, Terracotta Army, Hong Kong finale
china.whyParents: Walk a near-empty Great Wall, see the Forbidden City and Terracotta Army, then end with Hong Kong's harbour lights.
china.stay: Beijing Wangfujing (walk to Forbidden City), Xi'an inside city wall, Hong Kong Tsim Sha Tsui (harbour views)
china.getAround: Metro and DiDi rides in cities; private driver to Mutianyu (~1.5h each way); G-train Beijing West to Xi'an North ~4h10m to 5h.
china.entry: Visa-free 240-hour transit: enter from US/Korea, exit to Hong Kong, onward ticket required. Round trip needs L visa ($140).
events: Low season: no Chinese holidays Dec 13 to 19, thin crowds at the Wall
Hong Kong Symphony of Lights harbour show nightly at 8pm
Forbidden City closed Mondays (Dec 14); tickets release 7 days ahead, passport required
pros: Great Wall nearly empty in winter
Terracotta Army plus a 200 mph bullet train
No visa needed with the Hong Kong exit
cons: Visa ($140 + center fee) unless exiting via Hong Kong
Google blocked; set up Alipay and roaming eSIM first
unverified: All fares are estimates; no dated Dec 12/19 2026 open-jaw fare seen
Korean Air evening ICN-PEK connection time on Dec 13 (trackers show ~18:40 to 20:50)
Air China JFK-PEK winter 2026 frequency (5x weekly per summer data); proposed US ban on Chinese airlines using Russian airspace could change it
240-hour rule details from secondary sources plus MTR page; confirm with China's National Immigration Administration before booking
Visa application center service fee (one source totals ~$252 with service fee)
Mutianyu toboggan winter operation and the reported 60+ age limit
china.precip: Dry, sunny, windy; snow rare. Xi'an ~42F/27F, Hong Kong ~68F/59F
china.flightText: Korean Air out, Cathay Pacific home: Out Sat Dec 12: KE82 JFK 13:00 to Seoul ICN 17:45 Sun, evening KE flight to Beijing PEK (lands ~9pm Dec 13). Home: CX947 Xi'an 15:50 to Hong Kong 19:05 Fri Dec 18; CX840 HKG 16:30 to JFK ~7:30pm Sat Dec 19.. Open jaw ending in Hong Kong is what makes the trip visa-free. Cathay is oneworld (earn AA miles) and a Capital One transfer partner. Cheaper visa-free alternative: Korean Air both ways, home Xi'an-Seoul-JFK (Korea also counts as a third country). Air China nonstop JFK-PEK (5x weekly, 747-8) would land Mon Dec 14.

itinerary.title: Arrive Beijing (Sun Dec 13)
itinerary.plan: Land via Seoul ~9pm, taxi or driver to Wangfujing hotel (~45 min). Sleep.
itinerary.eat: Late snack at the hotel or a Wangfujing noodle shop

itinerary.title: Great Wall at Mutianyu
itinerary.plan: Private driver early. Cable car up, walk restored towers, toboggan down if open (riders 60+ may be refused).

itinerary.title: Forbidden City + Jingshan
itinerary.plan: Forbidden City (book 7 days ahead, bring passports), climb Jingshan Park for the view, hutong walk.

itinerary.title: Temple of Heaven, train to Xi'an
itinerary.plan: Early Temple of Heaven with locals doing tai chi, then G-train to Xi'an (~4.5h). Evening Muslim Quarter.
itinerary.eat: Roujiamo and biangbiang noodles, Muslim Quarter

itinerary.title: Terracotta Army
itinerary.plan: Driver or guide to the Terracotta Warriors (~1h). Pits 1 to 3 plus museum, back for evening.
itinerary.eat: Dumpling banquet at De Fa Chang

itinerary.title: City Wall bikes, fly to Hong Kong
itinerary.plan: Bike the Xi'an City Wall in the morning, 3:50pm flight to Hong Kong, evening harbour stroll.
itinerary.eat: Cantonese dinner in Tsim Sha Tsui

itinerary.title: Hong Kong morning, fly home
itinerary.plan: Star Ferry and Peak Tram views, airport by 1:30pm, 4:30pm nonstop lands JFK same evening.
itinerary.eat: Dim sum at Tim Ho Wan
